The build now finishes with 0 errors. The remaining 8 warnings are unrelated deprecation notices from the bumped package itself, not from your code.

Root cause: the bundler bump changed the options shape it passes to modules.

1. `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` treated any non-boolean as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as disabled.

Build now finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
